// Secrets are NOT inlined — set before running: APP_TOKEN
// Optional env (a default applies when unset): REGION
// Generated by Cairntrace `cairn export playwright`. Edit at your own risk —
// re-running export will overwrite. Source: /tmp/flows/host.yml
// Intent: preconditions, a run step, a capture, a polled outcome and a teardown through the bounded helper
// Lang: ts
//
// Preconditions run in this file's beforeAll (SKIP_PRECONDITIONS=1 skips them):
//   [reset] bun run reset
//   psql -c 'select 1' | head -1

import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { dirname, join, resolve } from "node:path";
import { spawn, spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { existsSync } from "node:fs";

const PUBLISHER_ONLY_ENV_KEYS = new Set(["FILECHEAP_INGEST_TOKEN"]);
const TVAULT_CONTROL_PREFIX = "TVAULT_";
const CAIRN_TVAULT_ENV = "CAIRN_TVAULT_ENV";
const COMMAND_OUTPUT_LIMIT = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
const COMMAND_TAIL_CHARS = 2000;
// The raw tail kept before redaction: wide enough that a secret cut at its
// start never survives into the redacted COMMAND_TAIL_CHARS.
const COMMAND_RAW_TAIL_CHARS = 4 * COMMAND_TAIL_CHARS;
const COMMAND_DRAIN_GRACE_MS = 500;
const COMMAND_SENSITIVE_NAME_RE = /authorization|cookie|set-cookie|token|secret|password|passwd|api[_-]?key|access[_-]?token|refresh[_-]?token|code[_-]?verifier|otp|passcode|credential|assertion|jwt|bearer/i;

/** A command that needs no shell: spawned as an argument vector. */
interface CairnArgv {
  argv: string[];
}

interface CairnCommandOptions {
  cwd: string;
  timeoutMs: number;
  env?: Record<string, string>;
  /** `$1…$n` of a shell command. */
  args?: string[];
  /** Resolve with the (bounded) stdout instead of "". */
  capture?: boolean;
  /** CAIRN_* run context layered under `env`. */
  context?: Record<string, string>;
  /** Names the command in errors (never its text: it may carry secrets). */
  label?: string;
  /** Env vars the command text read (${env.X} / ${secrets.X}): their values are scrubbed from errors. */
  redact?: string[];
}

/**
 * Run a host command with a hard deadline. A string runs through `/bin/sh -c`
 * (`cmd.exe` on Windows); a `{ argv }` is spawned without a shell. A non-zero
 * exit, a spawn error and the deadline reject; the deadline kills the whole
 * owned process tree. The error carries the output tail, never the command.
 */
async function cairnCommand(command: string | CairnArgv, options: CairnCommandOptions): Promise<string> {
  if (!existsSync(options.cwd)) {
    throw new Error(
      "Command cwd does not exist: " + options.cwd + ". " +
        "Set CAIRN_PROJECT_ROOT to the Cairntrace project root (the directory holding the source specs); this export may have been moved.",
    );
  }
  const label = options.label ?? "Command";
  const env = targetPreconditionEnv({ ...(options.context ?? {}), ...(options.env ?? {}) });
  const windows = process.platform === "win32";
  let file: string;
  let args: string[];
  if (typeof command === "string") {
    file = windows ? (process.env.ComSpec ?? "cmd.exe") : "/bin/sh";
    args = windows ? ["/d", "/s", "/c", command] : ["-c", command, "cairn-run", ...(options.args ?? [])];
  } else {
    file = command.argv[0]!;
    args = command.argv.slice(1);
  }
  return await new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
    const child = spawn(file, args, { cwd: options.cwd, env, stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"] });
    let stdout = "";
    let tail = "";
    let settled = false;
    let exited: { code: number | null; signal: NodeJS.Signals | null } | undefined;
    const finish = (error?: Error) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (error) reject(error);
      else resolve(options.capture ? stdout : "");
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      const killed = killProcessTreeSync(child.pid);
      finish(new Error(
        label + " timed out after " + options.timeoutMs + "ms; killed " + killed.length + " process(es) in the owned tree.",
      ));
    }, options.timeoutMs);
    timer.unref?.();
    child.stdout.setEncoding("utf8");
    child.stderr.setEncoding("utf8");
    child.stdout.on("data", (chunk: string) => {
      if (options.capture) stdout = (stdout + chunk).slice(-COMMAND_OUTPUT_LIMIT);
      tail = (tail + chunk).slice(-COMMAND_RAW_TAIL_CHARS);
    });
    child.stderr.on("data", (chunk: string) => {
      tail = (tail + chunk).slice(-COMMAND_RAW_TAIL_CHARS);
    });
    // Settle once the output is drained (the last stdout line of an `assign`
    // must not be lost), or shortly after the exit when a grandchild keeps
    // the pipes open — like `cairn run`.
    const settleExit = () => {
      if (settled || !exited) return;
      const { code, signal } = exited;
      if (code === 0) finish();
      else {
        const detail = signal ? " (signal " + signal + ")" : "";
        // Redact the whole kept output BEFORE cutting it: a secret straddling
        // the cut would survive as a partial no redactor recognizes.
        const safe = cairnRedactOutput(tail, options).slice(-COMMAND_TAIL_CHARS).trim();
        const output = safe ? ": " + safe.split("\n").slice(-5).join("\n") : "";
        finish(new Error(label + " failed with exit " + String(code) + detail + output));
      }
    };
    child.once("error", (error) => finish(error));
    child.once("exit", (code, signal) => {
      exited = { code, signal };
      setTimeout(settleExit, COMMAND_DRAIN_GRACE_MS).unref?.();
    });
    child.once("close", (code, signal) => {
      exited = exited ?? { code, signal };
      settleExit();
    });
  });
}

/**
 * Command output with every secret value scrubbed: sensitive-named env
 * (this process's, the command's own and its run context) and the
 * ${env.X} / ${secrets.X} values the command text read (`redact`).
 */
function cairnRedactOutput(text: string, options: { env?: Record<string, string>; context?: Record<string, string>; redact?: string[] }): string {
  const values = new Set<string>();
  const add = (raw: string | undefined, min: number) => {
    const value = String(raw ?? "").trim();
    if (value.length < min) return;
    values.add(value);
    for (const line of value.split(/\r?\n/)) {
      if (line.trim().length >= 8) values.add(line.trim());
    }
  };
  const env = { ...process.env, ...(options.context ?? {}), ...(options.env ?? {}) };
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(env)) {
    if (key !== "CAIRN_RUN_TOKEN" && COMMAND_SENSITIVE_NAME_RE.test(key)) add(value, 1);
  }
  // A short value (a flag, a region) is not told apart from ordinary text.
  for (const name of options.redact ?? []) add(process.env[name], 6);
  let output = text;
  for (const value of [...values].sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length)) {
    output = output.split(value).join("[redacted]");
  }
  return output;
}

/** A spec precondition: `cairnCommand` with the precondition label. */
async function runPrecondition(command: string | CairnArgv, options: CairnCommandOptions): Promise<void> {
  await cairnCommand(command, { ...options, label: options.label ?? "Precondition" });
}

/** The `run.assign` contract: the last non-empty stdout line is JSON. */
function cairnLastJson(stdout: string, label: string): unknown {
  const last = stdout
    .split("\n")
    .map((line) => line.trim())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .at(-1);
  if (last === undefined) throw new Error(label + ": assign: the command printed nothing on stdout");
  try {
    return JSON.parse(last) as unknown;
  } catch {
    throw new Error(label + ": assign: the last stdout line is not JSON");
  }
}

/** The CAIRN_* run context a `cairn run` command sees, from the running test. */
function cairnTestContext(
  info: { project: { use: { baseURL?: string } }; outputDir: string },
  runToken?: string,
  status?: string,
): Record<string, string> {
  const context: Record<string, string> = { CAIRN_RUN_DIR: join(info.outputDir, "cairn-run") };
  if (runToken) context.CAIRN_RUN_TOKEN = runToken;
  const baseUrl = info.project.use.baseURL;
  if (baseUrl) context.CAIRN_BASE_URL = baseUrl;
  if (status) context.CAIRN_RUN_STATUS = status;
  return context;
}

function targetPreconditionEnv(overrides: Record<string, string> = {}): Record<string, string> {
  const allowedTvaultKeys = new Set(
    Object.keys(overrides).filter((key) => key.startsWith(TVAULT_CONTROL_PREFIX)),
  );
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries({ ...process.env, ...overrides }).filter(
      (entry) =>
        entry[1] !== undefined &&
        !PUBLISHER_ONLY_ENV_KEYS.has(entry[0]) &&
        entry[0] !== CAIRN_TVAULT_ENV &&
        (!entry[0].startsWith(TVAULT_CONTROL_PREFIX) ||
          allowedTvaultKeys.has(entry[0])),
    ),
  ) as Record<string, string>;
}

function killProcessTreeSync(rootPid: number | undefined): number[] {
  if (!rootPid || !Number.isInteger(rootPid) || rootPid <= 1) return [];
  if (process.platform === "win32") {
    spawnSync("taskkill", ["/pid", String(rootPid), "/t", "/f"], {
      stdio: "ignore",
      timeout: 5_000,
      env: targetPreconditionEnv(),
    });
    return [rootPid];
  }
  const tree = [rootPid, ...descendantPidsSync(rootPid)];
  for (const pid of [...tree].reverse()) {
    try {
      process.kill(pid, "SIGKILL");
    } catch {
      // A process may exit between discovery and the signal.
    }
  }
  return tree;
}

function descendantPidsSync(rootPid: number): number[] {
  const descendants: number[] = [];
  const pending = [rootPid];
  const seen = new Set(pending);
  while (pending.length > 0) {
    const parentPid = pending.shift()!;
    for (const childPid of directChildPidsSync(parentPid)) {
      if (seen.has(childPid)) continue;
      seen.add(childPid);
      descendants.push(childPid);
      pending.push(childPid);
    }
  }
  return descendants;
}

function directChildPidsSync(pid: number): number[] {
  try {
    const result = spawnSync("pgrep", ["-P", String(pid)], {
      encoding: "utf8",
      timeout: 2_000,
      env: targetPreconditionEnv(),
    });
    if (typeof result.stdout !== "string") return [];
    return result.stdout
      .split("\n")
      .map((line) => Number(line.trim()))
      .filter((childPid) => Number.isInteger(childPid) && childPid > 1);
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

// Cairntrace page probe (capture / table): the same in-page resolver `cairn run` uses.
const CAIRN_PROBE_PREFIX = "(() => {\n  const cfg = ";
const CAIRN_PROBE_SUFFIX = ";\n\n  const norm = (s) => String(s == null ? \"\" : s).replace(/\\s+/g, \" \").trim();\n  const lower = (s) => norm(s).toLowerCase();\n  const same = (a, b, exact) => (exact ? norm(a) === norm(b) : lower(a) === lower(b));\n  const cap = (s, n) => (s.length > n ? s.slice(0, n) : s);\n  const isVisible = (el) => {\n    if (!el || !el.isConnected) return false;\n    if (typeof el.checkVisibility === \"function\") {\n      if (!el.checkVisibility({ checkOpacity: false, checkVisibilityCSS: true })) return false;\n    } else {\n      const style = getComputedStyle(el);\n      if (style.display === \"none\" || style.visibility === \"hidden\") return false;\n    }\n    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();\n    return rect.width > 0 || rect.height > 0 || el.getClientRects().length > 0;\n  };\n  const textOf = (el) => norm(el.innerText != null ? el.innerText : el.textContent);\n  const byIds = (ids) =>\n    norm(String(ids).split(/\\s+/).map((id) => document.getElementById(id)).filter(Boolean).map(textOf).join(\" \"));\n  const labelsOf = (el) => (el.labels ? Array.from(el.labels).map(textOf).filter(Boolean) : []);\n  const implicitRole = (el) => {\n    const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();\n    const type = (el.getAttribute(\"type\") || \"\").toLowerCase();\n    if (/^h[1-6]$/.test(tag)) return \"heading\";\n    switch (tag) {\n      case \"button\": case \"summary\": return \"button\";\n      case \"a\": case \"area\": return el.hasAttribute(\"href\") ? \"link\" : null;\n      case \"input\":\n        if (type === \"hidden\") return null;\n        if ([\"button\", \"submit\", \"reset\", \"image\"].includes(type)) return \"button\";\n        if (type === \"checkbox\") return \"checkbox\";\n        if (type === \"radio\") return \"radio\";\n        if (type === \"range\") return \"slider\";\n        if (type === \"number\") return \"spinbutton\";\n        if (type === \"search\") return el.hasAttribute(\"list\") ? \"combobox\" : \"searchbox\";\n        return el.hasAttribute(\"list\") ? \"combobox\" : \"textbox\";\n      case \"textarea\": return \"textbox\";\n      case \"select\": return el.multiple || el.size > 1 ? \"listbox\" : \"combobox\";\n      case \"option\": return \"option\";\n      case \"img\": return el.getAttribute(\"alt\") === \"\" ? \"presentation\" : \"img\";\n      case \"ul\": case \"ol\": case \"menu\": return \"list\";\n      case \"li\": return \"listitem\";\n      case \"table\": return \"table\";\n      case \"thead\": case \"tbody\": case \"tfoot\": return \"rowgroup\";\n      case \"tr\": return \"row\";\n      case \"td\": return \"cell\";\n      case \"th\": return el.getAttribute(\"scope\") === \"row\" ? \"rowheader\" : \"columnheader\";\n      case \"nav\": return \"navigation\";\n      case \"main\": return \"main\";\n      case \"header\": return \"banner\";\n      case \"footer\": return \"contentinfo\";\n      case \"aside\": return \"complementary\";\n      case \"form\": return \"form\";\n      case \"dialog\": return \"dialog\";\n      case \"progress\": return \"progressbar\";\n      case \"fieldset\": return \"group\";\n      case \"article\": return \"article\";\n      case \"section\":\n        return el.hasAttribute(\"aria-label\") || el.hasAttribute(\"aria-labelledby\") ? \"region\" : null;\n      default: return null;\n    }\n  };\n  const roleOf = (el) => {\n    const explicit = (el.getAttribute(\"role\") || \"\").trim().split(/\\s+/)[0];\n    return (explicit || implicitRole(el) || \"\").toLowerCase();\n  };\n  const NAME_FROM_CONTENT = [\"button\", \"link\", \"heading\", \"cell\", \"gridcell\", \"columnheader\", \"rowheader\",\n    \"option\", \"tab\", \"menuitem\", \"menuitemcheckbox\", \"menuitemradio\", \"checkbox\", \"radio\", \"switch\",\n    \"treeitem\", \"listitem\", \"row\", \"tooltip\"];\n  const accName = (el) => {\n    const labelledBy = el.getAttribute(\"aria-labelledby\");\n    if (labelledBy) { const t = byIds(labelledBy); if (t) return t; }\n    const ariaLabel = norm(el.getAttribute(\"aria-label\"));\n    if (ariaLabel) return ariaLabel;\n    const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();\n    if (tag === \"input\" || tag === \"textarea\" || tag === \"select\") {\n      const type = (el.getAttribute(\"type\") || \"\").toLowerCase();\n      if ([\"button\", \"submit\", \"reset\"].includes(type)) {\n        return norm(el.value || (type === \"submit\" ? \"Submit\" : type === \"reset\" ? \"Reset\" : \"\"));\n      }\n      if (type === \"image\") return norm(el.getAttribute(\"alt\"));\n      const labels = labelsOf(el);\n      if (labels.length > 0) return norm(labels.join(\" \"));\n      return norm(el.getAttribute(\"title\") || el.getAttribute(\"placeholder\"));\n    }\n    if (tag === \"img\") return norm(el.getAttribute(\"alt\") || el.getAttribute(\"title\"));\n    if (tag === \"table\") { const c = el.querySelector(\"caption\"); if (c) return textOf(c); }\n    if (tag === \"fieldset\") { const l = el.querySelector(\"legend\"); if (l) return textOf(l); }\n    if (NAME_FROM_CONTENT.includes(roleOf(el))) {\n      const t = textOf(el);\n      if (t) return t;\n      // Name from content includes images' alt text and labelled icons\n      // (<button><img alt=\"Close\"></button>), which innerText leaves out.\n      const inner = Array.from(el.querySelectorAll(\"img[alt], [aria-label], svg > title\"))\n        .map((n) => n.tagName.toLowerCase() === \"title\" ? n.textContent : (n.getAttribute(\"alt\") || n.getAttribute(\"aria-label\")))\n        .map(norm).filter(Boolean).join(\" \");\n      if (inner) return inner;\n    }\n    return norm(el.getAttribute(\"title\"));\n  };\n  const labelNames = (el) => {\n    const names = [];\n    const labelledBy = el.getAttribute(\"aria-labelledby\");\n    if (labelledBy) names.push(byIds(labelledBy));\n    names.push(norm(el.getAttribute(\"aria-label\")));\n    for (const l of labelsOf(el)) names.push(l);\n    return names.filter(Boolean);\n  };\n  const resolveLocator = (loc, testIdAttribute) => {\n    // Semantic locators see into open shadow roots, like the accessibility\n    // tree the backends resolve them through (selector / testid stay on the\n    // light DOM).\n    const all = () => {\n      const out = [];\n      const walk = (scope) => {\n        for (const el of scope.querySelectorAll(\"*\")) {\n          out.push(el);\n          if (el.shadowRoot) walk(el.shadowRoot);\n        }\n      };\n      if (document.body) walk(document.body);\n      return out;\n    };\n    let found;\n    if (loc.by === \"selector\") {\n      try { found = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(loc.selector)); }\n      catch (e) { return { error: \"invalid selector \" + JSON.stringify(loc.selector) + \": \" + String(e && e.message || e) }; }\n    } else if (loc.by === \"testid\") {\n      const attr = testIdAttribute;\n      found = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\"[\" + CSS.escape(attr) + \"]\"))\n        .filter((el) => el.getAttribute(attr) === loc.testid);\n    } else if (loc.by === \"role\") {\n      const role = String(loc.role).toLowerCase();\n      found = all().filter((el) => roleOf(el) === role && (loc.name === undefined || same(accName(el), loc.name, loc.exact)));\n    } else if (loc.by === \"label\") {\n      found = all().filter((el) => labelNames(el).some((n) => same(n, loc.name, loc.exact)));\n    } else {\n      const hits = all().filter((el) => same(textOf(el), loc.text, loc.exact));\n      found = hits.filter((el) => !hits.some((other) => other !== el && el.contains(other)));\n    }\n    if (loc.hasText) {\n      const needle = lower(loc.hasText);\n      found = found.filter((el) => lower(textOf(el)).includes(needle));\n    }\n    if (loc.near) {\n      const needle = lower(loc.near);\n      const distance = (el) => {\n        let depth = 0;\n        for (let node = el; node; node = node.parentElement, depth++) {\n          if (lower(textOf(node)).includes(needle)) return depth;\n        }\n        return Infinity;\n      };\n      const scored = found.map((el) => [el, distance(el)]);\n      const best = Math.min(...scored.map((pair) => pair[1]));\n      found = best === Infinity ? [] : scored.filter((pair) => pair[1] === best).map((pair) => pair[0]);\n    }\n    return { found };\n  };\n\n  const loc = cfg.locator;\n  const resolved = resolveLocator(loc, cfg.testIdAttribute);\n  if (resolved.error) return { error: resolved.error };\n  const found = resolved.found;\n  const visibility = found.map(isVisible);\n  const pool = cfg.includeHidden ? found : found.filter((_, i) => visibility[i]);\n  const describe = (el) => {\n    const isFormValue = \"value\" in el && [\"INPUT\", \"TEXTAREA\", \"SELECT\", \"OPTION\", \"BUTTON\"].includes(el.tagName);\n    const disabled = el.disabled === true ||\n      el.getAttribute(\"aria-disabled\") === \"true\" ||\n      Boolean(el.closest(\"fieldset[disabled]\"));\n    return {\n      visible: isVisible(el),\n      text: cap(textOf(el), 2000),\n      value: isFormValue ? String(el.value) : el.isContentEditable ? cap(textOf(el), 2000) : null,\n      attribute: cfg.attribute ? el.getAttribute(cfg.attribute) : null,\n      hasAttribute: cfg.attribute ? el.hasAttribute(cfg.attribute) : false,\n      enabled: !disabled,\n      tag: el.tagName.toLowerCase(),\n    };\n  };\n  const nth = typeof loc.nth === \"number\" ? loc.nth : undefined;\n  const out = {\n    total: found.length,\n    visibleCount: visibility.filter(Boolean).length,\n    poolCount: pool.length,\n    matches: pool.slice(0, 50).map(describe),\n  };\n  if (nth !== undefined) out.nthMatch = pool[nth] ? describe(pool[nth]) : null;\n  if (cfg.table) {\n    const target = nth !== undefined ? pool[nth] : pool.length === 1 ? pool[0] : pool.find(isVisible);\n    if (!target) {\n      out.table = null;\n    } else {\n      const isTable = (el) => el.tagName === \"TABLE\" ||\n        [\"table\", \"grid\", \"treegrid\"].includes((el.getAttribute(\"role\") || \"\").toLowerCase());\n      const table = isTable(target) ? target :\n        (target.querySelector(\"table, [role=table], [role=grid], [role=treegrid]\") || target);\n      const rows = table.tagName === \"TABLE\" ? Array.from(table.rows) : Array.from(table.querySelectorAll(\"[role=row]\"));\n      const cellsOf = (row) => row.tagName === \"TR\" ? Array.from(row.cells) :\n        Array.from(row.querySelectorAll(\"[role=cell], [role=gridcell], [role=columnheader], [role=rowheader]\"));\n      const isHeaderCell = (c) => c.tagName === \"TH\" || (c.getAttribute(\"role\") || \"\") === \"columnheader\";\n      let headerIndex = -1;\n      for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {\n        const cells = cellsOf(rows[i]);\n        if (cells.length === 0) continue;\n        const inHead = rows[i].parentElement && rows[i].parentElement.tagName === \"THEAD\";\n        if (inHead || cells.every(isHeaderCell)) { headerIndex = i; break; }\n        break;\n      }\n      const headers = headerIndex >= 0 ? cellsOf(rows[headerIndex]).map((c) => cap(textOf(c), 500)) : [];\n      const data = rows\n        .filter((row, i) => i !== headerIndex &&\n          !(row.parentElement && row.parentElement.tagName === \"THEAD\") &&\n          cellsOf(row).length > 0 && isVisible(row))\n        .map((row) => cellsOf(row).map((c) => cap(textOf(c), 500)));\n      out.table = { headers, rows: data.slice(0, 500), rowCount: data.length };\n    }\n  }\n  return out;\n\n})()";

interface CairnProbeMatch {
  visible: boolean;
  text: string;
  value: string | null;
  attribute: string | null;
  tag: string;
}

interface CairnTable {
  headers: string[];
  rows: string[][];
  rowCount: number;
}

interface CairnProbeResult {
  poolCount: number;
  matches: CairnProbeMatch[];
  nthMatch?: CairnProbeMatch | null;
  table?: CairnTable | null;
  error?: string;
}

interface CairnCaptureOptions {
  timeoutMs: number;
  includeHidden: boolean;
  attribute?: string;
  testIdAttribute?: string;
}

function cairnDescribeLocator(locator: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const by = String(locator.by);
  const base = by === "role" ? "role=" + String(locator.role) + (locator.name !== undefined ? " " + JSON.stringify(locator.name) : "") : by === "label" ? "label " + JSON.stringify(locator.name) : by === "text" ? "text " + JSON.stringify(locator.text) : by === "selector" ? String(locator.selector) : "testid " + String(locator.testid);
  const extra = [
    typeof locator.nth === "number" ? "nth " + locator.nth : "",
    locator.near ? "near " + JSON.stringify(locator.near) : "",
    locator.hasText ? "hasText " + JSON.stringify(locator.hasText) : "",
  ].filter(Boolean);
  return extra.length > 0 ? base + " (" + extra.join(", ") + ")" : base;
}

async function cairnProbe(
  page: Page,
  locator: Record<string, unknown>,
  options: CairnCaptureOptions,
  table: boolean,
): Promise<CairnProbeResult> {
  const config = {
    locator,
    testIdAttribute: options.testIdAttribute ?? "data-testid",
    attribute: options.attribute ?? null,
    table,
    includeHidden: options.includeHidden,
  };
  const probe = (await page.evaluate(CAIRN_PROBE_PREFIX + JSON.stringify(config) + CAIRN_PROBE_SUFFIX)) as CairnProbeResult;
  if (probe && typeof probe.error === "string") throw new Error(probe.error);
  return probe;
}

/** The single target of a locator: pool[nth], or the only (visible) match. */
function cairnSingleTarget(
  probe: CairnProbeResult,
  locator: Record<string, unknown>,
): { match?: CairnProbeMatch; error?: string } {
  const described = cairnDescribeLocator(locator);
  if (typeof locator.nth === "number") {
    return probe.nthMatch ? { match: probe.nthMatch } : { error: "nth " + locator.nth + " is out of range: " + probe.poolCount + " match(es) for " + described };
  }
  if (probe.poolCount === 0) return { error: "no element matches " + described };
  if (probe.poolCount === 1) return { match: probe.matches[0]! };
  const visible = probe.matches.filter((match) => match.visible);
  if (visible.length === 1 && probe.poolCount <= probe.matches.length) return { match: visible[0]! };
  return { error: probe.poolCount + " elements match " + described + "; add nth (0-based) or a more specific locator" };
}

/** capture.table: `{ headers, rows: [{ header: cell }], cells, rowCount }`. */
function cairnTableCapture(table: CairnTable): Record<string, unknown> {
  const headers = table.headers.map((header, index) => (header.length > 0 ? header : "column" + (index + 1)));
  const rows = table.rows.map((cells) => {
    const row: Record<string, string> = {};
    cells.forEach((cell, index) => {
      row[headers[index] ?? "column" + (index + 1)] = cell;
    });
    return row;
  });
  return { headers: table.headers, rows, cells: table.rows, rowCount: table.rowCount };
}

/** A capture step: retry every 250ms until the target resolves or the budget is spent. */
async function cairnCapture(
  page: Page,
  kind: "text" | "value" | "attribute" | "table",
  locator: Record<string, unknown>,
  options: CairnCaptureOptions,
): Promise<unknown> {
  const started = Date.now();
  let last = "no attempt";
  for (;;) {
    try {
      const probe = await cairnProbe(page, locator, options, kind === "table");
      if (kind === "table") {
        if (probe.table) return cairnTableCapture(probe.table);
        last = "no element matches " + cairnDescribeLocator(locator);
      } else {
        const target = cairnSingleTarget(probe, locator);
        if (!target.match) {
          last = target.error ?? "no target";
        } else {
          const value = kind === "text" ? target.match.text : kind === "value" ? target.match.value : target.match.attribute;
          if (kind === "value" && value === null) last = cairnDescribeLocator(locator) + " is not a form control (" + target.match.tag + ")";
          else return value;
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      last = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    }
    const elapsed = Date.now() - started;
    if (elapsed >= options.timeoutMs) throw new Error("capture " + kind + ": " + last);
    await page.waitForTimeout(Math.min(250, options.timeoutMs - elapsed));
  }
}

/** Polled outcome with a stability window (verifier `poll.stableMs`). */
async function cairnPoll(
  attempt: () => Promise<void>,
  options: { timeoutMs: number; everyMs: number; stableMs: number },
): Promise<void> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + options.timeoutMs;
  let greenSince: number | undefined;
  let greenSamples = 0;
  let lastError: unknown;
  for (;;) {
    try {
      await attempt();
      const now = Date.now();
      greenSince ??= now;
      greenSamples += 1;
      lastError = undefined;
      if (now - greenSince >= options.stableMs && greenSamples >= 2) return;
    } catch (error) {
      greenSince = undefined;
      greenSamples = 0;
      lastError = error;
    }
    const remaining = deadline - Date.now();
    if (remaining <= 0) break;
    const untilStable = greenSince !== undefined ? Math.max(50, greenSince + options.stableMs - Date.now()) : options.everyMs;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, Math.min(options.everyMs, untilStable, remaining)));
  }
  if (lastError !== undefined) throw lastError;
  throw new Error("polled outcome was green for only " + (greenSince === undefined ? 0 : Date.now() - greenSince) + "ms of the required " + options.stableMs + "ms before the " + options.timeoutMs + "ms deadline");
}

/** Render a captured value like Cairntrace's runtime ${requests|evals|artifacts.…} splice. */
function cairnSplice(root: unknown, path: string[]): string {
  let value = root;
  if (value === undefined) return "";
  for (const key of path) {
    if (value !== null && typeof value === "object" && key in value) {
      value = (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
    } else {
      return "";
    }
  }
  if (value === undefined || value === null) return "";
  return typeof value === "object" ? JSON.stringify(value) : String(value);
}

const RUN_TOKEN = process.env.CAIRN_RUN_TOKEN ?? Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10);

test.beforeAll(async () => {
  if (process.env.SKIP_PRECONDITIONS === "1") {
    return;
  }
  // Derived from sequential step/outcome budgets (+10% headroom, at least 1m); 4h ceiling.
  test.setTimeout(225000);
  await runPrecondition({ argv: ["bun", "run", "reset"] }, { cwd: resolve(dirname(test.info().file), "../flows"), timeoutMs: 45000, label: "Precondition \"reset\"", context: cairnTestContext(test.info(), RUN_TOKEN), env: { "APP_TOKEN": String(`${process.env.APP_TOKEN ?? ""}`) }, redact: ["APP_TOKEN"] });
  await runPrecondition("psql -c 'select 1' | head -1", { cwd: resolve(dirname(test.info().file), "../flows"), timeoutMs: 120000, label: "Precondition 2", context: cairnTestContext(test.info(), RUN_TOKEN), env: { "APP_TOKEN": String(`${process.env.APP_TOKEN ?? ""}`) }, redact: ["APP_TOKEN"] });
});

test("golden_host_commands", async ({ page }) => {
  // Derived from sequential step/outcome budgets (+10% headroom, at least 1m); 4h ceiling.
  test.setTimeout(300000);

  // Values captured by request/eval/download `assign:` for later ${…} splices.
  let cairnRuns_seeded: unknown;
  let cairnCaptures_title: unknown;

  let cairnRunStatus: string = "failed";
  try {
    // --- steps ---
    // step: seed
    cairnRuns_seeded = cairnLastJson(await cairnCommand({ argv: ["node", resolve(dirname(test.info().file), "../scripts/seed.mjs"), "create", `${RUN_TOKEN}`] }, { cwd: resolve(dirname(test.info().file), "../flows"), timeoutMs: 30000, label: "run node seed.mjs → seeded", context: cairnTestContext(test.info(), RUN_TOKEN), capture: true }), "run node seed.mjs → seeded");
    // step: open_item
    await page.goto(`/items?id=${cairnSplice(cairnRuns_seeded, ["id"])}&region=${(process.env.REGION || "eu")}`);
    // step: read_title
    cairnCaptures_title = await cairnCapture(page, "text", { "by": "role", "role": "heading", "name": "Item" }, { timeoutMs: 5000, includeHidden: false, testIdAttribute: "data-answer-key" });
    // step: echo_title
    {
      for (let fillAttempt = 0; ; fillAttempt++) {
        await page.getByLabel("Echo").first().fill(`${cairnSplice(cairnCaptures_title, [])}`);
        await page.waitForTimeout(500);
        try {
          await expect(page.getByLabel("Echo").first()).toHaveValue(`${cairnSplice(cairnCaptures_title, [])}`, { timeout: 500 });
          break;
        } catch (err) {
          if (fillAttempt >= 3) throw new Error("hydration wiped value after 4 attempts", { cause: err });
        }
      }
    }

    // --- outcomes (the contract) ---
    // banner: the saved banner shows and stays
    await expect(async () => {
      await expect(page.locator("body")).toContainText("Saved", { ignoreCase: true, useInnerText: true });
    }).toPass({ timeout: 15000, intervals: [500] });

    // stays: the status stays done
    await cairnPoll(async () => {
      // one instantaneous sample, like cairn run: each assertion checks once (no auto-retry)
      const cairnSampleExpect = expect.configure({ timeout: 1 });
      await cairnSampleExpect(page.locator("body")).toContainText("Done", { ignoreCase: true, useInnerText: true });
    }, { timeoutMs: 10000, everyMs: 1000, stableMs: 2000 });

    cairnRunStatus = "passed";
  }
  finally {
    // spec teardown: runs on every exit path (CAIRN_RUN_STATUS = cairnRunStatus)
    const cairnTeardownDeadline = Date.now() + 60000;
    const cairnTeardownErrors: string[] = [];
    // teardown 1/1: cleanup
    if (Date.now() >= cairnTeardownDeadline) {
      cairnTeardownErrors.push("cleanup: teardown budget of 60000ms exhausted");
    } else {
      try {
        // step: cleanup
        await cairnCommand({ argv: ["node", "../scripts/clean.mjs"] }, { cwd: resolve(dirname(test.info().file), "../flows"), timeoutMs: Math.max(1, Math.min(120000, cairnTeardownDeadline - Date.now())), label: "run shell", context: cairnTestContext(test.info(), RUN_TOKEN, cairnRunStatus) });
      } catch (error) {
        cairnTeardownErrors.push("cleanup: " + (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)));
      }
    }
    for (const message of cairnTeardownErrors) {
      console.warn("[teardown] " + message);
      test.info().annotations.push({ type: "teardown-failed", description: message });
    }
    if (cairnTeardownErrors.length > 0 && cairnRunStatus === "passed") {
      throw new Error("teardown failed (failRun): " + cairnTeardownErrors.join("; "));
    }
  }
});
